issue_context.title: grouping function can't just be recreated with function name and args because it has additional metadata
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)

<!-- a step by step guide for reproducing the bug. -->
```
CREATE TABLE `t` (
  `year` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `country` varchar(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `product` varchar(32) DEFAULT NULL,
  `profit` int(11) DEFAULT NULL
) 
alter table t set tiflash replica 1;
select year, country, product, grouping(year, country, product) from sales group by year, country, product with rollup having grouping(year, country, product) <> 0;
```
### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)
MySQL
```
mysql> select year, country, product, grouping(year, country, product) from sales group by year, country, product with rollup having grouping(year) > 0;
Empty set (0.02 sec)

mysql> explain select year, country, product, grouping(year, country, product) from sales group by year, country, product with rollup having grouping(year) > 0;
+----+-------------+-------+------------+------+---------------+------+---------+------+------+----------+----------------+
| id | select_type | table | partitions | type | possible_keys | key  | key_len | ref  | rows | filtered | Extra          |
+----+-------------+-------+------------+------+---------------+------+---------+------+------+----------+----------------+
|  1 | SIMPLE      | sales | NULL       | ALL  | NULL          | NULL | NULL    | NULL |    1 |   100.00 | Using filesort |
+----+-------------+-------+------------+------+---------------+------+---------+------+------+----------+----------------+
1 row in set, 1 warning (0.01 sec)
```

### 3. What did you see instead (Required)
TiDB
```
tidb> select year, country, product, grouping(year, country, product) from sales group by year, country, product with rollup having grouping(year, country, product) <> 0;
ERROR 1105 (HY000): Meta data is not initialzied
```

### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required)

<!-- Paste the output of SELECT tidb_version() -->
master

review_comments: There raise a question that, do we need to throw panic for the `NewFunctionInternal` since it doesn't init meta for `grouping`?

1: I just mark it as deprecated here, the later usage will be notified to change. (blocking for coming)
2: for old code logic that encountering grouping function without initialization here. (prevent for existence)
* the terror.Log(err) in `newFunctionInternal` will log out the error trace in planner layer.
* client side will got evaluation error for grouping function in execution layer.

If necessary, we can definitely  throw the error out OR make a strong assertion there:
1: migrate all `newFunctionInternal` ref to `newFunction`
2: change Terror.Log(err) as Assert(err) to be not nil to panic if breaking
grouping function's meta is a kind of BitMask used to compute the grouping value based on the gid column
